caseName: Thompson v. Property Tax Appeal Board
caseNameFull: Thompson et ux. v. Property Tax Appeal Board of Illinois

opinions.text: Appeal from App. Ct. 111., 2d Dist., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied. Reported below: 22 111. App. 3d 316, 317 N. E. 2d 121.
